notes.title: Our new game the Steam store page for 'Bait Soul' is now live!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Dear Players,[/b][/h1]

[h2]Happy New Year! We’re excited to finally share our new game — Bait Soul — with you at this special time![/h2]

Bait Soul is a top-down action roguelike where players can freely combine various elements to create their own ultimate combat style. Explore the unknown depths and face waves of formidable enemies in a challenging journey.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3484100/_Bait_Soul/

Currently, we are working hard to develop and refine the game, and we look forward to sharing the demo with you soon.

Though the official release is still some time away, we’ll continue to share the latest updates and progress with you. Be sure to follow us for the latest development news, and feel free to share your valuable feedback and suggestions to help us create a better game together.

[b][h2]- BOLD FISH -[/h2][/b]
